headline: Find the KOLs who actually move your product
summary: Confetti connects Singapore brands with the right Key Opinion Leaders to drive real conversions on TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada.
facts: Confetti operates as an official TikTok Shop Partner and Shopee MCN agency based in Singapore.
Confetti serves both local Singapore brands and overseas brands entering the Singapore market.
benefits: Full campaign management, end to end
steps: Define your campaign goal and platform
Select KOLs by conversion fit, not just reach
Publish and monitor in real time
Report on sales outcomes, not just reach
